That which is the site of the verbs शीङ् 'to lie down', स्था 'to stand', आस् 'to sit', when preceded by the preposition अधि , is however called कर्म कारक or object.

Terms: कारक-अधिकरण

The words अधि and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used as mere expletives.

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय

The words अधि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'lord' ('being as a lord' or 'having as a lord')

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय

A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त , when the force of the latter is to denote 'locality' in which something happened

Terms: समास-विभक्ति-6

Of the verbs having the sense of 'remembering', (अधिक्), and of दय 'to give', 'to pity', 'to protect', 'to move' and of ईश 'to rule or be master of', the object takes the 6th-Case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-6
The past participle ending in क्त is used with the Genitive 6th-Case, when the former expresses location -- क्तोऽधिकरणे च ध्रौव्यगतिप्रत्यवसानार्थेभ्यः

A द्वन्द compound denoting a fixed number (एकत्व) of concrete things (अधिकरण) is not singular.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

The affix अच् comes after the verb शी 'to lie down' when in composition with a case-inflected word indicating location i.e. in the Locative -7th-case.

Terms: अच्

And when 'wish' is meant ( the लोट् (Imperative) may be used when the word स्म is in composition with the verb.

Terms: लोट्

The affix णमुल् comes after the बन्ध् 'to bind' when a word expressing location is in construction with it.

Terms: णमुल्

An affix comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'made in relation to any subject' when the thing made is a 'book'.

Terms: विभक्ति-2

The word अधिक is anomalous.

Terms: Anomalous

The affix धा comes after a Numeral when the sense is a change in the apportionment or distribution of substances.

Terms: धा
